postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of queries for each test case is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The indices l and r are valid for each query, with l < r and the substring s[l:r] having an even length.
The minimum cost to make the given substring a correct bracket sequence is non-negative.

invariants.expression: The string s contains only round ('(' and ')') and square ('[' and ']') brackets.
invariants.description: The input string s consists of only round and square brackets.

invariants.expression: The length of s is at least 2.
invariants.description: The input string s has a length of at least 2 characters.

invariants.expression: Each substring s[l:r] has an even length.
invariants.description: Each query specifies a substring with an even length.
